must: Preserve the existing information architecture and audited dispatcher boundaries.
Use plain language on primary surfaces and never expose internal task IDs.
Reserve relief for controls that answer a press; relief is permitted, not mandatory.
Keep navigation tabs visually part of the chrome with a flat underline selected state.
Keep the substrate at ground level and elevation within the closed three-level scale.
Keep every visual effect below the amber attention edge unless it occludes that edge.
Keep provider brand marks at their own brand color or monochrome treatment.
Provide visible focus, keyboard access, responsive reachability, and reduced-motion liveness.
avoid: multi-hue or unbounded gradients and repeating atmospheric grids
structural or workflow changes during this visual-only overhaul

decisions.decision: Treat relief as an optional affordance for explicit command actions, not a universal style for every interactive element.
Top navigation and suggestion rows remain flat; active navigation uses an underline and suggestions use rule-separated hover and focus states.
The overhaul changes visual presentation only and preserves the current UI structure and audited action paths.
Precision Instrument is selected. External agent products inform tonal hierarchy, borders, typography, density, and interaction states only; Hivemind structure and placement do not change.
Use 21st as grounded catalogue research and code review while retaining one Hivemind primitive family; install no mixed-author component set.

Orca-derived Hivemind supersedes Precision Instrument. The official stablyai/orca source at commit 9d06b3ba938d3c5467de5b82b0bec322af2620a8 supplies the curve, alpha, density, and solid-control relationships; Hivemind keeps its navy hues, structure, workflows, and audited dispatcher.
decisions.source: User direction plus fresh official Orca clone and installed-app review

decisions.decision: Keep Orca as the material foundation and concentrate Hivemind identity in a slightly bluer surface ladder, one same-hue primary-action face with a pressed inverse, a hex-node navigation line, and one quiet self-hosted interlocking-field asset in unused space. Secondary controls, navigation relief, structure, and behavior remain unchanged.
decisions.source: User approval plus installed build 26.820.1055 review

decisions.decision: Settings follows Setup's single shared provider-row family, puts no-cost CLI-detected model slugs beside the planner, manager, and worker jobs, and moves file risk, checks, and work-kind routing behind one flat Advanced disclosure. Paid capability checks remain explicit committed actions with their measured cost shown before pressing.
decisions.source: User request plus repository design context and 21st review

decisions.decision: The empty Work surface is a conventional centered chat composer with the existing 14px radius token and one circular committed send action. Submitting moves that same form to the panel footer immediately; examples and introductory instructions are removed rather than restyled.
decisions.source: User request plus installed build 26.820.1508 review

decisions.decision: The visible project-name control opens the existing recent-project switch path plus the native folder picker. Active tabs use a plain centered underline with no hex node. The idle composer uses the 18px radius step, a full-width 15px prompt field, and a balanced action row; docked geometry remains compact.
decisions.source: User request plus installed build 26.820.1621 review

decisions.decision: Work alone owns the first-request composer. Before durable work exists, Agents shows a quiet explanatory empty state with no action; once work exists, it becomes the authoritative agent graph while retaining the shared run shell.
decisions.source: User request plus installed build 26.820.1827 review

decisions.decision: The idle Work field becomes a denser single connected drawing at the existing 7% ceiling and may breathe slowly only when the OS allows decorative motion. It is removed at submit time, before durable work arrives. The centered composer advances to the 22px radius step and exposes one compact Agents menu whose planner, manager, and worker choices read no-cost detected slugs and change roles only through the existing capability-checked dispatcher action.
decisions.source: User request plus project-aware 21st build review
